title: Account settings
purpose: Change your details, language, training software and emails, or ask us to delete your account.
noProfileTitle: We could not find your CAD Champions profile
noProfileText: Your profile may still be being created. Try again in a minute, or tap Need help? and we will check it for you.

errors.saveBody: Check your connection and try again. If it keeps happening, tap Need help?.
errors.sessionBody: Your session ended for safety. Sign in and try again.
errors.phoneInvalid: This phone number does not look right. Use a Qatar number like 5555 1234, or add the country code for an international number.

details.title: Your details
details.purpose: We use these to personalise your training and to reach you if your test needs attention.
details.fullNameHelp: As you want it to appear on your certificates.
details.phoneHelp: So we can reach you on WhatsApp if your test needs attention.
details.savedText: Your profile is up to date.

language.title: Language
language.purpose: The language of this site and of your emails.
language.help: We remember your choice on this device and in your account. You can change it any time.

track.title: Training software
track.purpose: Decides which videos and examples you see in training.
track.help: Pick the program you will build your models in. Your test can be done in any software.
track.savedText: Your lessons will use this software.

email.title: Email preferences
email.purpose: Choose which emails you get from us. Account and security emails are always sent.
email.weeklyHint: A short summary of what you did and what to do next.
email.marketingHint: Occasional emails about new courses, events and competitions.

password.title: Change password
password.purpose: Use a password you do not use anywhere else.
password.savedText: Use your new password next time you sign in.
password.errorTitle: We could not change your password
password.errorSame: Choose a password that is different from your current one.
password.errorRecent: For safety, please sign out, sign in again, then change your password.
password.errorGeneric: Please try again. If it keeps happening, tap Need help?.

deletion.title: Delete my account
deletion.purpose: Ask us to remove your account and everything stored with it.
deletion.help: An admin reviews every request, usually to make sure it really is you. You can cancel the request any time before it is approved.
deletion.whatGoes: If you go ahead, we delete your profile, test uploads, results and training progress. This cannot be undone.
deletion.retention: Deletion happens within [TODO-MO: retention days] days after an admin approves your request.
deletion.dialogBody: We will delete your profile, test uploads, results and training progress within [TODO-MO: retention days] days after an admin approves. This cannot be undone. You can cancel the request until then.
deletion.requestedText: We will review your request and email you.
deletion.pendingTitle: Your deletion request is waiting for review
deletion.pendingBody: Requested on {date}. Nothing has been deleted yet. Changed your mind? You can cancel it.
deletion.cancelledText: Your account stays as it is.
deletion.errorTitle: We could not update your deletion request
deletion.errorBody: Please try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, tap Need help? and we will do it for you.
